question_text: How does the speed of sound in seawater compare to the speed of sound in air?
hint: Think about the density difference between water and air

options: Sound travels about 5 times faster in seawater than in air
Sound travels about the same speed in both seawater and air
Sound travels about 2 times slower in seawater than in air
Sound travels about 10 times slower in seawater than in air
